spec.title: Memory Cached
spec.description: OS page cache used by the container. Reclaimable under memory pressure.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: CPU time consumed per container as a percentage of one core. Values above 100% mean more than one core is in use (e.g. 250% = 2.5 cores).

spec.title: Container Writable Layer
spec.description: Current disk usage of the container's copy-on-write layer. Excludes volumes, bind mounts, and tmpfs.

spec.title: Memory Refaults
spec.description: Workingset refaults — pages evicted under memory pressure, then needed again; sustained values mean the working set doesn't fit in memory. `anon` = swap-backed (severe), `file` = page cache (milder).

spec.title: Memory Refaults
spec.description: Workingset refaults — pages evicted under memory pressure, then needed again; sustained values mean the working set doesn't fit in memory. `anon` = swap-backed (severe), `file` = page cache (milder).

spec.title: Dirty / Writeback
spec.description: Unflushed page-cache backlog. `dirty` = modified but not yet written to disk; `writeback` = currently flushing. Growing values mean writes outpace the disk (I/O backpressure).
